name: voice-iris
description: Voice Iris by UV: an audio-reactive WebGL2 orb for voice interfaces. A Claude skill that adds a beautiful, real-time voice-reactive orb to your React and Next.js apps and connects it to audio playback, microphones, and voice SDKs.

plugins.name: voice-iris-by-uv
plugins.description: Voice Iris by UV: integrate an audio-reactive WebGL2 orb into React or Next.js applications. Features six voice states, four visual styles, customizable palettes, real-time audio visualization, microphone input, audio element integration, and voice SDK support. Built with React and WebGL2. MIT.
